name: POST /api/ai-gateway/tenant-credentials — bind tenant provider key
description: Binds a tenant's own AI provider API key (BYOK, FR-BYOK-3). The raw key is enveloped by the credential service and the response deliberately contains only the binding metadata plus a last_4 — never raw_key and never credential_envelope, which is the primary security assertion for this endpoint. Optional model_allowlist restricts which models may use the tenant key, and fallback_on_error controls whether a failing tenant key falls back to the platform credential. QA edge cases: provider_id must be one of exactly anthropic, openai, bedrock or gemini — anything else is a 400 naming the unsupported value; raw_key must be a string of at least 8 characters, so a short or trimmed-to-empty key is a 400 rather than a provider-side failure at call time; every non-validation failure, including a duplicate active binding for the same (tenant_id, provider_id), surfaces as a 500 rather than a 409, so a re-bind test must expect 500 with the constraint message; the actor recorded on the binding falls back to the literal 'tenant-admin-ui' when the JWT carries no persona_id or sub; a model_allowlist that omits the model actually requested later does not fail here — it silently causes fall-through to the platform credential at completion time. VA·E3 (TK-4497/4498): a key is bound for a voice layer — layer (llm | stt | tts | realtime | telephony, default llm) and priority (primary | secondary, default primary) — so a tenant can hold a primary and a secondary key per layer (75b4234b-efcc-474a-81a5-22f480e9c151#AC1); provider_id must be offered on that layer (llm: anthropic, openai, bedrock, gemini, groq, cerebras, together, fireworks, deepinfra, mistral, xai; stt: deepgram, assemblyai, openai; tts: cartesia, elevenlabs, deepgram, openai; realtime: openai, gemini, bedrock; telephony: twilio, telnyx). Binding again for the same (provider, layer, priority) revokes the previous key. tenant_id is optional and defaults to the JWT tenant; naming another tenant is 403. The response is a reference only — binding_id, last_4 and lifecycle/capacity metadata (validation_status, rate_limit_tier, max_concurrency) — never raw_key or the envelope, and failures never echo or log the request body (75b4234b-efcc-474a-81a5-22f480e9c151#AC2).

testCases.name: Bind an OpenAI key for the tenant

errorCases.when: the body is absent or any of tenant_id, provider_id or raw_key is missing or empty
provider_id is not offered on the requested layer

errorCases.message: raw_key must be a non-trivial string
errorCases.when: raw_key is not a string or is shorter than 8 characters
unexpected storage/encryption failure (details are logged without the request body)

errorCases.message: layer must be one of llm, stt, tts, realtime, telephony
errorCases.when: layer is not a voice layer

errorCases.message: priority must be primary or secondary
errorCases.when: priority is not primary or secondary

errorCases.message: tenant_id does not match the authenticated tenant
errorCases.when: an explicit tenant_id names another tenant than the JWT
no Authorization header, or it is not of the form 'Bearer <jwt>' (requireAuth preHandler)
the bearer JWT fails verifyJwt — bad signature, wrong JWT_SECRET, or exp already elapsed (requireAuth preHandler)
